{{for|the similarly named [[Andoran]] queen|Morrigan}}
'''Varuna Morrigan''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]] who was raised to the [[Amyrlin Seat]] in the year {{Ne|638}}.  She served as the Amyrlin from {{ne|638}} until {{ne|681}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Varuna Morrigan}}

==History==

Varuna's name could indicate [[Andor|Andoran]] origin (see [[Morrigan]]).

Varuna held the position for forty-three years until her death in {{Ne|681}}. She was [[Gerra Kishar]]'s successor and [[Cemaile Sorenthaine]]'s predecessor.{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Varuna was an Amyrlin of average strength and influence. As a Green she focused on the [[Borderlands]], feeling that the battle there against [[Shadowspawn]] was more important than any meddling with nations farther south. This effectively reduced the [[White Tower|Tower]]'s power and influence to the south.

Her focus on the Borderlands and external matters also left the [[Hall of the Tower|Hall]] largely in control of the White Tower and the Aes Sedai.

===Events===

The following events occurred during Varuna's reign:
# The [[Great Winter War]] was fought between [[Andor]] and [[Cairhien]].
# The [[Kin]] Elder [[Ivara]] went to the Tower.
# [[Gitara Moroso]] was born.{{Ref/book|0|2}}
